tanks.label: 1.6 m Al-Li barrel
tanks.note: Dry mass is propellantMass × structuralFraction at safety factor 1.4. Cylinder volume, domes not added.

tanks.label: 3.7 m stainless barrel
tanks.note: Heavy booster tank. Steel is cheap per kilogram and thick.

tanks.label: 5 m common-bulkhead hydrolox
tanks.note: Shared dome is about 8% lighter than two separate barrels of this volume. Insulation is in the cost, not the dry mass.

tanks.label: 1.2 m titanium sphere pair
tanks.note: Two spheres for a storable kick stage. Volume is two full spheres.

tanks.label: 3.7 m to 2.5 m composite adapter
tanks.note: Dry structure only. Mass is composite areal density times the frustum lateral area.

tanks.label: 2.4 m stringer-stiffened aluminum-copper
tanks.note: External stringers are in the structural fraction, not a separate mass.

tanks.label: 1.5 m glass-phenolic motor case
tanks.note: Solid case uses 9% of propellant mass, scaled by structuralFraction / 0.045. Not for liquid hydrogen.
